notes: Poster timing diagnostic build. Keeps the complete regression-safe 1.6.6 runtime unchanged and adds measurement only. A.C.E. now shows a small elapsed poster timer in the artifact panel and records poster milestones including first job observation, OpenDesign run assignment, stage changes, PPTX availability, first usable preview and completion. OpenDesign HTTP-call durations are also logged when they can be associated with the poster. Detailed timing is written to ~/Library/Logs/ACE-Poster-Timing.log. Docker SearXNG search, poster generation, Preview/Edit, voice, theme, Stop and source recall remain on the 1.6.6 implementation.
